readme:
# Cell annotation batch 2

Five new cell contours: two complete isolated-cell crops from E-plus and three selected peripheral-cell crops (S). Class 0: visible_cell. Original source train/val assignments are preserved.

IMPORTANT: review/images and review/labels contain PARTIAL annotations, with unlabelled neighbouring cells and uncertain contact boundaries. They must NOT be included in normal YOLO training or validation. Use them for visual review and further annotation only. training_eligible=false is also recorded in annotations.json.

The two complete isolated crops are under images/train and labels/train. The six accepted previous examples remain in extraction_annotation_pilot_v1. No training or model evaluation performed. Cells touching an aggregate are visually more ambiguous than isolated cells; these masks are drafts, not biological ground truth.
